title: New Zealand archives reveal Kaikoura cover-up and squid boat explanation

tellings.quote: I discovered that there'd been this release of the New Zealand archives in about 2011.

plain: New Zealand government archives released around 2011 are said to show a cover-up of the Kaikoura sightings, the 1978 reports of strange lights off New Zealand's coast, and to show where the official explanation that the lights were squid fishing boats came from. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels he found the release himself. He does not say which files said what, and he dates the release only as "about 2011."
